name: Zinfizzlex's Portable Shredder Unit
label: Quest
description: Zinfizzlex's Portable Shredder Unit: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm as anxious as you are to try out my portable shredder unit, traveler, but before I can make the kit, I'm going to need materials - lots of materials!
To be exact, I'm going to need a mountain of thorium, mithril, and iron. I will also need one steamsaw per unit. You'll have to get those at the lumber mill.
When I was nosing around in here (before my capture) I noticed a pile of steamsaws at the Frostwolf lumber camp.
